Contract staffingLeave cover, short projects or roles you prefer to keep off your own payroll, such as data entry and office boys.A builder's office in Anna Nagar needing two data entry operators for a six-month records project

What matters when hiring for office staff in Tamil Nadu

Office roles look simple, yet a poor hire is costly because these people handle visitors, cash, records and client calls. Accounts assistants should be tested on Tally entries, GST invoice basics and bank reconciliation, not on CV wording. Data entry operators are tested for typing speed and accuracy in English, and sometimes in Tamil. Receptionists are judged on spoken English and Tamil, phone manner and how they deal with a difficult visitor.

Pay expectations for office staff differ sharply across Tamil Nadu. A receptionist in Guindy or on OMR expects more than one in Salem or Madurai, and commute time weighs heavily for women candidates. We match candidates to offices within a practical travel distance, because long bus rides are a frequent reason for resignations in the first few months.

Office staff in shops and commercial establishments are covered by Tamil Nadu's minimum wage notifications, which were revised from 1 April 2026 (TN Labour Department, as of Nov 2026). Staff placed on an agency's payroll must be covered by PF and, for wages up to Rs 21,000 a month, by ESI (ESIC, as of Nov 2026). Check the current notified rate before you fix an offer.

What we check before sending candidates

  • Test typing speed and accuracy for data entry roles
  • Give accounts candidates a short Tally and GST invoice exercise
  • Assess spoken English and Tamil for front office roles
  • Check the two-wheeler licence of office boys who run outside errands
  • Take a reference call on previous employment and reason for leaving
  • Confirm the commute distance from home to your office

Office staff hiring: questions employers ask

Can you send a receptionist on short notice?

Often, yes. Receptionists and front desk staff are among the roles we can shortlist fastest, and first profiles reach you within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles. Speed depends on your location, timings and salary. A Guindy office with a 9.30 to 6 schedule fills faster than one that needs Saturday evenings. For leave cover, a contract placement avoids adding to your rolls.

Do you test accounts assistants before sending them?

Yes. Accounts candidates complete a short practical task before we share their profile. It covers Tally voucher entry, a GST invoice and a simple bank reconciliation. We send you the result along with the CV, so you see actual skill rather than claims. For senior accounts roles, your own auditor or CA may want to run a second round.

What does it cost to hire office staff through you?

Our charge is [Lifeline's fee: to confirm]. For context, agencies in India commonly bill a permanent hire at 8.33% to 16.67% of yearly CTC, which works out to one to two months' salary. Contract staff are billed monthly as salary plus PF, ESI and a service charge, with 18% GST, generally on the full invoice. These are market figures, not our rates.

Is there a trial period for office staff?

Probation is set by you, not by us, and many offices use three to six months for support roles. Our replacement terms, if a placed person leaves or does not fit, are [replacement terms: to confirm]. If you want a longer trial, a contract-to-hire arrangement lets the person work on our payroll before you take them on directly.

Can office boys also handle bank and courier work?

Yes, if you say so in the requirement. Office boys who run outside errands need a valid two-wheeler licence, basic reading in English and Tamil, and a record that lets you trust them with cash and cheques. We check the licence and take a reference from a previous employer for such roles. Give us your errand list so we screen for it.
